scope: Two PB2 substitutions only; literature associations, not a comprehensive phenotype screen. Reference positions are native full-length PB2 coordinates.

entries.statement: PB2 E627K was associated with increased replication and virulence in the studied H5N1 mouse model.
entries.study_context: Hong Kong/1997 H5N1 experimental virus backgrounds; mice. Effect in the WINGS sample is not established by sequence alone.

entries.statement: PB2 D701N was implicated in replication of the studied duck H5N1 viruses in mice.
entries.study_context: Duck H5N1 experimental backgrounds; mouse infection. Replication and lethality depended on multiple genes; transfer to the WINGS sample is uncertain.
